title: Enumerate Method Flow leaf paths before exact reads
failure_signature: A read assumed nested record and witness directories even though the phase stored Method Flow leaf files directly under its method-flow directory.
candidate_workaround: Enumerate exact leaf filenames first and read only a returned path.
recurrence_guard: Treat phase Method Flow storage layout as discoverable state, not an inherited directory convention.
rollback: Retain the failed path assumption and rerun the read against an enumerated leaf path.
scope_boundary: Filesystem path discovery only; it does not validate Method Flow content.
